title: Study on the interaction between epicatechin gallate and bovine myosin and its enhancement of protein structure and function.
authors: Zheng, Wentao; Wan, Xiaohui; Zhang, Duoduo; Ding, Jiwei; Ma, Bohan; Shu, Qin; Liu, Yongfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯与牛肌球蛋白的相互作用及其对蛋白结构和功能的增强，使用光谱和分子模拟方法，虽以食品蛋白为对象，但涉及蛋白结构计算建模，可借鉴其分子对接与相互作用分析思路。
abstract: Bovine myosin is a critical protein influencing meat product quality, yet its conformation is susceptible to destabilization during processing. This study investigated the interaction mechanism between epicatechin gallate (ECG) and bovine myosin, as well as its regulatory effects on protein structure and functional properties. Spectroscopic analyses revealed that ECG bound to myosin through static quenching, altering the microenvironment of aromatic amino acid residues. FTIR further showed that ECG induced protein secondary structure rearrangement and promoted the formation of beta-sheet structure. Molecular simulation revealed that hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions were the dominant forces for stabilizing ECG-myosin binding. Glu331, Ile326 and Asp242 were identified as the key residues for the stable binding of the complex. Interestingly, at an ECG concentration of 100 mumol/L, the polyphenol binding rate reached 25.76%, DPPH radical scavenging capacity increased by approximately 5.2-fold, surface hydrophobicity markedly decreased, and solubility was enhanced by nearly 6-fold. In vitro digestion experiments showed that ECG delayed protein hydrolysis in the gastric phase but promoted both protein digestion and polyphenol release in the intestinal phase. Collectively, ECG significantly improved the physicochemical and functional properties of bovine myosin, and providing a scientific basis for the application of tea polyphenols in meat protein systems.
abstract_zh: 牛肌球蛋白是影响肉制品品质的关键蛋白质，但其构象在加工过程中易失稳。本研究探讨了表儿茶素没食子酸酯（ECG）与牛肌球蛋白之间的相互作用机制，及其对蛋白质结构和功能特性的调控作用。光谱分析表明，ECG通过静态猝灭与肌球蛋白结合，改变了芳香族氨基酸残基的微环境。FTIR进一步显示，ECG诱导蛋白质二级结构重排，并促进β-折叠结构的形成。分子模拟揭示，氢键和疏水相互作用是稳定ECG-肌球蛋白结合的主要驱动力。Glu331、Ile326和Asp242被鉴定为复合物稳定结合的关键残基。有趣的是，在ECG浓度为100 μmol/L时，多酚结合率达到25.76%，DPPH自由基清除能力提高约5.2倍，表面疏水性显著降低，溶解度提升近6倍。体外消化实验表明，ECG在胃相中延缓了蛋白质水解，但在肠相中促进了蛋白质消化和多酚释放。总体而言，ECG显著改善了牛肌球蛋白的理化及功能特性，为茶多酚在肉蛋白系统中的应用提供了科学依据。
